paragraphs: Hyman writes: In the Jerusalem Talmud this is Rav Huna, and Rabbi Chuna is R' Huna.[^1]

notes.text: The source explicitly writes full Rav Chuna in the heading, full Rav Huna in the first body clause, and full Rabbi Chuna in the second. The final Huna title is abbreviated ר' and remains R'. Hyman's two equivalences are preserved as his affirmative statements, with their Rav and Rabbi distinctions; they do not create an authority identity merge or establish that every occurrence refers to the same person. No particular Jerusalem Talmud passage or whole-corpus comparison was supplied or freshly inspected for this notice. The earlier full Rabbi Huna rendering and historical model PASS remain archived.
